alignment.policy: Join only on exact date; do not forward-fill macro or fabricate missing rows. Refresh upstream datasets independently.

walkForward.model: expanding-window ridge regression, training-only standardization, fixed L2=1, horizon-purged labels, explicit breadth-macro interaction terms
walkForward.baseline: expanding historical mean and macro-only ridge

limitations: Fixed-current-constituent breadth is retrospectively selected; point-in-time model claims are not supported.
2025 external retrospective cohort excluded from walk-forward due to provenance mismatch.
Feature availability at historical close depends on upstream data provenance; requires audit.
Only one fixed ridge penalty and limited history; no hyperparameter tuning or statistical significance claims.
Offset cohorts are not independent of each other.
No source data is invented or filled and production scores are unchanged.
